svg.title: TOPAK I1 — Seats.tla: a principal holds one seat, and a seat's kind bounds what it may do. Two invariants, each broken by its own mutation: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean
svg.desc: The module ADR-0037 §9 asks for, drawn from its own text and from every results file about it, all read at build time: the machine, its two properties and the section each states, the mutation matrix, the witnesses, every theorem and lemma, the certified run, the Lean re-encoding and its check against TLC's state graphs. What is checked or proved here is checked or proved of the module, at its constants or by its proofs, and not of the reference; a model of the code's apply that refines it is drawn at the end, as a model. The module is frozen: cited by digest (Genesis Checkpoint G5, ADR-0046, ADR-0053) and unchanged since 2026.09.29, it models the three kinds and the Build column ADR-0037 §4 had then, not the kinds the record has gained since.

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

text.tspan: The mechanism, as the module states it: a grant seats one principal on one seat with its kind's alphabet, and every act is recorded with the kind of the seat it came from

svg.text: alphabet Read, Draft, Emit
alphabet Read, Emit, Vote
alphabet Read, Emit, Vote
① ~lease[s].live: the seat is free
② ~HoldsElsewhere(p, s): p holds no live lease on another seat (ADR-0037 §1, §9). M_SEAT drops it.
③ the lease is issued KindBound(KindOf[s]), whatever was asked (§4). M_KIND issues all of Acts.
Nothing changes: no lease, no act.
one record per admitted act: [act |-> a, kind |-> KindOf[s]]
OnlyThinkersAuthor: an authoring act only from
a thinker seat, and Vote never from one
OneSeatPerPrincipal: two live leases never
belong to one principal
asks: Grant(p, s)
④ a live lease
⑤ Act(s), line 57
⑥ EndRound(s), line 63: the lease becomes NoLease

Key. ① to ③ are Grant's conjuncts in order; ④ is the lease it writes; ⑤ an act from the live alphabet, recorded with the seat's kind; ⑥ ends a lease and nothing else. Dotted blue lines show what each property reads. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the module's definitions below; red marks where each mutation acts.

Also stated: heldB_iff, which the results file lists and reports no axioms for.
graph-check.sh dumps TLC's state graph for each Mut and evaluates the mirror on it: every edge a Next step, every Next
step an edge or a stutter, the same initial states, every property TLC's value in every state. A test, not a proof: the mirror's
theorems are the proof.
lean/TopakSpec-results-2026.10.06b.txt and lean/GraphCheck-results-2026.10.06.txt are the files ADR-0053
cites. The later TopakSpec-results-2026.10.07.txt and GraphCheck-results-2026.10.07.txt are compared, and say
the same of Seats.
Each theorem takes as hypothesis only the mutation that breaks it, as in TLAPS (Seats.lean's header).

A test, not a proof: every recorded code step is a model step, the direction the proofs need (SeatsModel.lean's header).
That the code is the model: the model is written from the Rust and read against it, and the replay tests it; ADR-0053 §5 names the route (enc-faithful, T-0045-37).
Anything at constants other than the module's for model_refines_seats; model_inv holds at any number of seats and principals.

text.tspan: Acts the module does not have

svg.text: The module's Acts are Read, Draft, Emit, Vote: Invoke and Submit are not among them, so Draft alone stands for "writes, runs or offers" (§4), and Vote for both Vote
and Vote(deny). The module's own comment says the second.

text.tspan: Kinds the record gained after the module

svg.text: operator (ADR-0037 A4, ratified in Batch 34) and emergency (A3, Batch 34): ADR-0050 and ADR-0052 state their own modules, Operators.tla and Emergency.tla.
orchestrator (A5) is pending and not applied.
None of them is a kind of Seats.tla, which is not edited: its theorems are about three kinds.
§4's Run column (A1, after ADR-0043 §2) is RunSeats.tla's, whose M_OBSEMIT is the provisional column A1 struck (ADR-0037 A1). This module has the Build column
only.
Principal, seat, cell: what an agent is made of
Alphabets by seat: nine variants and a control alphabet of six, two domains, five seat kinds (a sixth Proposed)
The trusted base: a component enters only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued
Theorem to premise: what every checked or proved property rests on, and what is void at the reference
Verification map: what is checked, what is proved, what must fail, and what neither claims
The Lean route: a second derivation, in three uses and one kernel

The corpus's specifications form a graph: layers are open, every edge is typed by what it leaves to a person, a guarantee carries its givens, and a theorem is inherited at the grade of its weakest edge
